caption: Table S2 Current conservative modality-specific counts in the post-hoc 159-unit stratum
note: N=159 in every row; L=cumulative layer, u=unknown. Current means the 6 November integration of exact NEG117 B3 judgments over the preserved earlier analysis. The machine-readable results contain all 84 modality cells and complementary sets. Direct and derived proofs remain separate. A, B1 and B2 retain their earlier source-specific assessments, whereas B3 incorporates the later targeted 117-dossier verification. Between-layer differences therefore reflect both added sources and differences in verification timing and intensity; they do not isolate the effect of adding a source category.
